text:
Ana P: FYI Jordan A. is starting Mon 2026-04-05 in the Tokyo region and hit a remote I-9 exception. We need to schedule an in-person ID verification + badge pickup and (if possible) a one-day parking permit. Who can coordinate local logistics? @Leo @Sam

Sam (IT): I can prepare and ship the laptop + temporary creds tomorrow morning. Need a confirmed pickup window and the name on the signature.

Leo (Facilities): We have a badge kiosk window Mon09:00-11:30 JST at the Tokyo satellite hub. I can block 10:15 for a quick verification and badge print. Parking permit requires a signed access form from People Ops.

Jordan A.: 10:15 JST works for me. I9m coming in from Saitama so morning train is fine. Is there a short check-in form I should fill beforehand?

Ana P: Yes, please complete the pre-checkin form and upload ID scans if possible: https://redwood.example/hr/checkin (one-time token sent to your email). If you can9t upload, bring originals to the kiosk.

Mika (Buddy): I9ll meet Jordan at reception and escort them. Mika -> please arrive ~10:00 to check in at the desk. :wave:

Sam (IT): Laptop delivery ETA to Facilities 08:45 JST. I9ll leave the IT asset tag and temporary Wifi creds with Leo. Example creds (will be rotated): SSID=redwood-guest, PW=Welcome2026!

Leo (Facilities): Blocked 10:15 and created the parking form: https://redwood.example/facilities/permits/tokyo. Ana, can you confirm the signed access form so I can issue the permit?

Ana P: Confirmed 09:30 04/05 02026: I uploaded the signed access form and added Jordan to the visitor roster. Opened background-check ticket BG-4721 04/01 02026; one address history item (2019) needs clarification. Jordan, please upload a short explanatory note or supporting doc.

Jordan A.: Uploading a note and a scanned rental agreement now to BG-4721. Thanks for the heads-up.

hr-bot: Background check BG-4721 status: pending docs. Please upload supporting doc (utility bill or lease) within 72 hours to avoid processing delay. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ana P: Day-1 checklist (Mon): 1) Jordan uploads BG doc; 2) Jordan completes pre-checkin form; 3) Mika escorts at 10:15; 4) Sam confirms laptop handoff; 5) Leo issues badge + parking permit. Fallback plan: if badge printing delayed, run remote orientation via Zoom at 11:30 JST and issue temporary guest badge.

Sam (IT): Adding a VPN quick-start note on the desktop and a first-login script. Snippet for reference:
```
# VPN setup
open "redwood.app/vpn-setup"
enter temporary token sent to email
```

Mika (Buddy): I9ll schedule a brief 30-min intro at 11:00 JST to cover benefits links, IT checklist, and first-day agenda. Jordan 04/05 bring a government ID for verification. :thumbsup:

Jordan A.: Done 04/01 02026: uploaded rental agreement and check-in form. See you Monday 10:15. Appreciate the help! :smile:

Ana P: Thanks team 04/01. I9ll send a calendar invite to the group and mark the visitor slot closed. Closing this coordination thread.
